overall_reason: The fixed header keeps a filled STORE button and a named menu button at both widths and the stylesheet declares hover, focus-visible, active and disabled looks, but every other destination sits behind the menu even at 1440 and the capture could not open it.

score.reason: T-PRIMARY-COUNT and T-STATE-MATRIX pass on the declared states; T-WHERE-AM-I fails on the menu-only header at 1440 (CMP-154), and T-OVERLAY-CHECK and T-ERROR-PATH could not run because this capture has no interaction record.

findings.evidence: The components table lists four header items at 1440: 'Lando Home', 'Store STORE', 'Open navigation menu' and 'Go to home'. The tile shows the logo, the LN mark, the lime STORE button and an icon-only menu square, with about 1,000 px of empty header between them. No nav region carries a current mark.
findings.before: At 1440 every destination except the store sits behind the icon-only menu button.
findings.after: Show the top destinations (On Track, Off Track, Helmets, Store) as text links in the header from about 960 px, with the current one marked by aria-current; keep the menu button under 60rem.
findings.why: A visitor on a desktop cannot see where the site goes or where they are without opening the menu first.
findings.title: Under ~60rem links that no longer fit go behind a menu

findings.evidence: The table's button variants give the lime STORE family a 7 px radius at heights 40, 50 and 60 px, and the menu button a 10 px radius at 60 px. The two sit side by side in the header with visibly different corners.
findings.before: The STORE button and the menu button are 60 px tall with radii of 7 px and 10 px.
findings.after: Use one corner radius for every header control.
findings.why: Two neighbouring controls with different corners read as two kits.
findings.title: Controls belong to one family

strengths: The fixed header keeps STORE and a named 'Open navigation menu' button at 375 and at 1440 (phone_nav toggle 49x49, tiles/375-00.png).
The stylesheet declares the control states: hover 46, focus-visible 3, active 3, disabled 10 rules in 1,480 readable rules.
On Track and Off Track get one equal lime button each under their own heading (tiles/1440-07.png): two parallel paths, not two competing primaries.
